name: aproda-aldc
description: Aproda ALDC toolkit for Visual Studio Code projects.

languageModelTools.name: aprodaAldc_readConfiguration
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the authoritative aldc.yaml configuration for the current ALDC project. Use this before making a decision that depends on ALDC configuration, including the toolkit root, plans root, Aproda toolkit version, or BCQuality settings. It resolves the repository root from workspace folders, so it works when the repository root is not itself a workspace folder. It is read-only and returns a structured result. Do not use it for general source-code questions.

commands.title: Aproda ALDC: Apply Toolkit to Project (per Repo)
Aproda ALDC: Check for Extension Updates

aprodaAldc.devRoot.markdownDescription: Developer root used by future Aproda ALDC tooling, for example `I:/Florian Köll`.

aprodaAldc.bcquality.path.markdownDescription: Central BCQuality-Aproda clone. Defaults to `<developer root>/BCQuality-Aproda`.

aprodaAldc.bcquality.setEnvInWorkspace.markdownDescription: Set BCQUALITY_HOME in reconciled workspace settings.

aprodaAldc.bcquality.autoFixWorkspacePat.markdownDescription: Keep BCQuality roots and settings aligned in project workspace files.

aprodaAldc.gettingStartedUrl.markdownDescription: Aproda ALDC onboarding documentation opened by the Onboarding Guide command.

aprodaAldc.source.mode.markdownDescription: Toolkit source mode. Use `managed` unless you maintain the Aproda toolkit.

aprodaAldc.source.forkPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local Aproda ALDC toolkit fork. Used only in `localFork` mode.

aprodaAldc.source.repositoryUrl.markdownDescription: Repository used by the managed toolkit cache.

aprodaAldc.pinnedVersion.markdownDescription: Toolkit version to use when the channel is `pinned`, for example `1.2.0_aproda.9`.

aprodaAldc.pwshPath.markdownDescription: PowerShell executable used by later project commands.

aprodaAldc.startupCheck.enabled.markdownDescription: Check for a newer Aproda ALDC toolkit when an AL project opens.

aprodaAldc.startupCheck.intervalHours.markdownDescription: Minimum time between automatic toolkit update checks.

aprodaAldc.extensionUpdate.enabled.markdownDescription: Check for and offer to install newer Aproda ALDC VSIX releases.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with the Aproda ALDC Toolkit
walkthroughs.description: Configure the extension, apply the toolkit, install BCQuality, set up Azure CLI, validate the result, and read the onboarding guide.

steps.title: Configure settings (one-time setup)
steps.description:
Sets the developer root, toolkit source/channel, BCQuality location, and update checks. One-time per workstation; you can re-run this anytime.

[Configure Aproda ALDC settings](command:aprodaAldc.setup).

steps.title: Apply the toolkit (per repository)
steps.description:
Initializes or updates the currently open AL project (a Git repository with an `app.json`) from the toolkit cache. Overlay-only — it never deletes project files.

[Apply the toolkit](command:aprodaAldc.initProject) to the current project.

steps.title: Install BCQuality (one-time setup)
steps.description:
BCQuality is the shared, external knowledge base used by code review (Dredd, review subagent). One-time per workstation, not per project.

[Install or update BCQuality](command:aprodaAldc.installBcQuality).

steps.title: Set up Azure CLI for ADO integration (one-time setup)
steps.description:
Required only for `skill-aproda-ado`'s CLI operations (work item/PR fetch, PR creation, work item updates). One-time per workstation.

Run in a terminal:

```powershell
az extension add --name azure-devops
az login --tenant 8ad57af3-4ca5-4c66-bc7d-a52dd71dc7c9 --subscription bdcf3613-1ee6-4c3c-9caf-962112b8a6aa
```

If `az boards`/`az repos` later reports a missing MSAL cache token, see the troubleshooting note in the onboarding guide. This step has no linked command — mark it done manually once complete.

steps.title: Validate the installation
steps.description:
Runs a compliance check against the applied toolkit. If it fails, use **Environment Diagnostics** or **Show Log** from the Command Palette to troubleshoot.

[Validate Installation](command:aprodaAldc.validate).

steps.title: Read the onboarding guide
steps.description:
Covers agent routing, ADO work item integration, and the Deploy-Run-Verify Cycle.

[Open the Aproda ALDC onboarding guide](command:aprodaAldc.gettingStarted).
